standard.title: Specification for Woodruff Keyslot Milling Cutters with Parallel Shank (First Revision) (पैरेलल शंक वाले वुड्रफ की-स्लॉट मिलिंग कटर की विशिष्टि (पहला पुनरीक्षण))
standard.sector: Production and General Engineering / Cutting Tools
standard.description: This Indian Standard prescribes the standardized physical dimensions, tolerances, materials, and testing requirements for woodruff keyslot milling cutters integral with parallel shanks (Type A with straight teeth), designed specifically for machining precise semi-circular keyslots or seatings in rotating shafts to accommodate standard Woodruff keys.
standard.scope: This Indian Standard prescribes the standardized physical dimensions, tolerances, materials, and testing requirements for woodruff keyslot milling cutters integral with parallel shanks (Type A with straight teeth), designed specifically for machining precise semi-circular keyslots or seatings in rotating shafts to accommodate standard Woodruff keys.

certification.description: Voluntary Product Certification. Every manufacturer of Woodruff keyslot cutters is highly encouraged to obtain a valid BIS license to stamp or emboss the physical ISI 'Standard Mark' on the packaging, indicating compliance with IS 2669.
requirements: Observed or calculated final test values, dimensional parameters, thicknesses, and tolerances must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2:1960. The decimal places retained should match that of the specified value in the standard.

Cutters are specified by the nominal diameter (d1) and nominal width (b), such as 10.5 mm diameter (widths 2.0, 2.5, 3.0), 16.5 mm diameter (widths 3.0, 4.0, 5.0), and up to 32.5 mm diameter (widths 8.0, 10.0), matching standard keys to IS 2294.
Tolerances on the nominal cutter diameter (d1) are held to h11 limits to prevent loose keyslots or key wobble in operation.
Tolerances on the cutter width (b) must conform to e8 limits to maintain exact lateral clearance of the Woodruff key inside the machined seat.
Shank diameter (d2) tolerances are strictly specified as h8 (or h6) to ensure a snug, concentric slip-fit inside the machine spindle chuck, minimizing tool runout.
The sides of the cutter must be hollow-ground to a slight concave depth to provide side relief, preventing friction heat and galling against the keyslot walls during deep plunge cutting.

High-Speed Steel cutters must have cutting teeth hardened and tempered to a minimum hardness of 62 to 65 HRC. The parallel shank portion must have a hardness of not less than 30 to 50 HRC to prevent scratching from the chuck.

Woodruff cutters are designated by name, diameter, width, standard number, and material. Example: A woodruff keyslot milling cutter of diameter d1 = 19.5 mm and width b = 5.0 mm, made of HSS and featuring Type A straight teeth: 'Woodruff Keyslot Cutter 19.5 x 5.0 IS : 2669 HSS'.
